title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary: Bitcoin is pricing in zero Fed hikes ahead of any official signal, with supply mechanics now driving price over policy noise. At the US close, BTC sits at 62,894 after a 2.6 percent drop, touching a daily low near 62,500 before partial recovery. Fear and Greed holds at 27. Hashrate climbs to 987 EH/s while long-term holder supply keeps rising, draining liquid coins.
